<RuleLanguageLinks current="javascript" languages={[{"id":"javascript","label":"JavaScript (and super languages)","href":"/linter/rules/no-dynamic-require/javascript/"}]} />

:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noDynamicRequire`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`import/no-dynamic-require`](https://github.com/import-js/eslint-plugin-import/blob/main/docs/rules/no-dynamic-require.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noDynamicRequire": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `require()` calls whose module name isn't a fixed string.

`require()` accepts any value as the module name, including names built while the
program runs, such as `require("./locales/" + language)`. When the name is built this
way, editors, bundlers, and other tools can't tell which file gets loaded. They can't
check that the file exists, include it in a bundle, or find every place that uses it.

This rule reports calls to `require()` whose first argument is anything other than a plain
value written in the code, such as a string or a template literal without `${}`
placeholders. Calls without arguments aren't reported. Calls to a `require` function
declared in your own code aren't reported either.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
require(name);
```

### Valid

```js
require("../name");
require(`../name`);
```

## Options

### `checkDynamicImports`

Default: `false`

When `true`, the rule also reports `import()` calls whose module name isn't a fixed string.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noDynamicRequire": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"checkDynamicImports": true
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

```js
import(`./locales/${language}.js`);
```
